reason: No ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set, so the planner's notes were not generated.
as_of_means: The day this placeholder was written, not the day any note was generated — no note has been. Every other file in this directory dates its data; this one dates its refusal, so the audit that checks every published file carries a date is answered honestly rather than by accident.
note: This file exists deliberately. build_planner_notes.py still writes nothing when it has no key — the honest behaviour it was designed for — but the page requesting a file that does not exist produced a 404 on every visit. A 200 that says plainly 'not generated' is better than a 404 that says nothing, and the page reads the generated flag rather than inferring absence from a failed fetch. A real run overwrites this whole file.
